minecraft_block_marker.description: A single gray stone-textured cube hovers just above the horizon line in every front and threequarter frame (t3, t8, t20); it does not move or change between ticks. Top view shows only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile and scattered soil specks.
minecraft_block_marker.notes: Identical in all ticks — could be a static scene prop rather than an emitted particle effect.

minecraft_crit.description: No particles or geometry visible in any frame. Front and threequarter rows are pure sky-over-grass; top frames contain only the persistent dirt-debris pile and scattered soil specks (background).
minecraft_crit.notes: Effect likely too small, expired before t3, or spawned outside the camera frame.

minecraft_dripping_water.description: A few tiny blue square droplets hang above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; nothing at t20. Top view shows only the dirt-debris background.
minecraft_dripping_water.notes: Only a handful of specks per frame; individual droplets barely resolve.

minecraft_enchanted_hit.description: No particles or geometry visible in any frame. Front and threequarter rows are empty sky-over-grass; top frames contain only the persistent dirt-debris pile and scattered soil specks (background).
minecraft_enchanted_hit.notes: Possibly expired before t3 or too small to register at this capture distance.

minecraft_falling_nectar.description: Sparse pale-yellow specks above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views; a lone pale speck in threequarter t8 and one pale dot resting on a debris clump in top t8; nothing at t20.
minecraft_falling_nectar.notes: Very few pixels; specks could be mistaken for texture noise.

minecraft_gust.description: Front t3 shows a bright white curved swirl — a crescent/arc of streaked particles with a denser puff at its lower end — above the horizon; threequarter t3 shows a smaller fainter arc of specks. Nothing at t8 or t20 in any row; top views show only debris.
minecraft_gust.notes: Strongly visible only at t3; the burst resolves before t8.

minecraft_item_snowball.description: One tiny white square speck above the horizon in front t3 and a similar faint speck in threequarter t3; no particles at t8 or t20 in any row. Top views show only the debris pile.
minecraft_item_snowball.notes: Only 1-2 specks total across all nine frames; borderline between faint effect and noise.

minecraft_poof.description: A loose burst of white and light-gray puffy specks above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views, still present but shifted and sparser at t8, absent at t20. Top views show only debris.

minecraft_small_flame.description: A cluster of small orange and yellow flame sprites above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views; a single orange speck remains at threequarter t8; nothing at t20. Top views show only debris.

minecraft_spore_blossom_air.description: Scattered small green square particles drift above the horizon in front and threequarter views at all three ticks, thinning but still present at t20; top t3 additionally shows a light-green patch overlapping the dirt pile.
minecraft_spore_blossom_air.notes: Particles sit in the sky band of front/threequarter cells; the top-view green patch confirms presence near the anchor.

minecraft_warped_spore.description: A sparse handful of tiny dark (near-black) specks drifts above the horizon in front and threequarter views at t3, t8 and t20; top views show only the debris pile.
minecraft_warped_spore.notes: Specks are very small and dark; color read (black vs dark teal) uncertain at this resolution.

world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_ACTIVATE.description: No particles, beam, or animated geometry visible in any frame. Front and threequarter rows are empty sky-over-grass; top frames contain only the persistent dirt-debris pile and scattered soil specks (background).
world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_ACTIVATE.notes: This is a block-animation event; the animated block itself may sit outside the captured frame or the animation was not triggered.

world_event_PARTICLES_EGG_CRACK.description: A burst of bright green four-pointed star/sparkle particles scatters above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; only two faint green sparkles remain at t20. Top views show only debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_EGG_CRACK.notes: Green sparkle color is unusual for the literal shot name but is what the pixels show.

world_event_PARTICLES_SMASH_ATTACK.description: No particles or geometry visible in any frame. Front and threequarter rows are empty sky-over-grass; top frames contain only the persistent dirt-debris pile and scattered soil specks (background).
world_event_PARTICLES_SMASH_ATTACK.notes: Smash dust may have spawned below the frame or expired before t3.

world_event_PARTICLES_WAX_OFF.description: Small pale peach/cream star-plus sparkles float above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views, thinning to a few faint specks at t20. Top views show only debris.

superheroes_goku_kamehameha_core.description: A compact cluster of orange-gold four-pointed star sparkles hovers above the horizon at all three ticks in front and threequarter views, slightly sparser and drifted at t20. Top views show only debris.
superheroes_goku_kamehameha_core.notes: Cluster stays anchored at the same sky position across ticks — reads as a persistent glowing core rather than a burst.

superheroes_homelander_roar_dust.description: A large turbulent cloud of hundreds of tiny dark specks billows above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views; by t8 it has stretched into a thinner drifting stream, and by t20 only a few faint specks remain. Top t3 shows dark specks scattered over the grass around the debris pile.
superheroes_homelander_roar_dust.notes: Largest and densest effect in the batch; unmistakable at t3.

superheroes_naruto_clone_poof.description: A few faint pale specks float above the horizon at t3, t8 and t20 in front and threequarter views; top t20 shows a distinct soft pale-gray puff patch resting on the grass.
superheroes_naruto_clone_poof.notes: Front/threequarter specks are extremely faint; clearest evidence is the pale puff patch in top t20.

superheroes_shamak.description: A compact irregular cluster of small black specks hovers above the horizon in front and threequarter views at t3 and t8; at t20 it survives as a few faint gray specks shifted rightward. Top views show only the debris pile plus a stray reddish speck at t3.

vfxlab_laser_beam.description: A thin bright cyan horizontal streak sits at the very top edge of every front cell (t3, t8, t20); threequarter t3 shows a faint cyan sliver at the same top edge; threequarter t8/t20 and all top cells show only the baseline scene.

scale_impression: thin sliver; full beam likely out of frame

vfxlab_laser_beam.notes: Only a top-edge sliver of the beam is inside the frame; full width, length and structure cannot be judged from this capture.
